decisions.reason: The 518 FLEX extends the proven BASIC 518 trommel, which already has a customer base, so its value is largely confirmed and keeping it costs little.
The flail shredder line had its own prominent page and fits the core mobile processing business, and no evidence has shown its value is unlikely to be realized, so the option stays open.

The mobile grinder line is only weakly documented, but after dropping the green-waste grinder it is the remaining grinder option in the core mobile segment, so keeping it is worthwhile while results come in.
This single stationary fine shredder has low visibility and overlaps with other shredders, which makes it the most likely candidate for abandonment, but no negative results justify dropping it yet.
The stationary pre-shredder line is prominently presented and supports the strategic push toward plant solutions, so it is kept as an option for further commitment.
